prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Refine this exact logo into a tasteful finished bespoke JRPG wordmark with MORE authentic chain construction and more distinctive lettering, while retaining its spare two-line composition.

PRESERVE composition and scale: "Chrono" upper line, "Chain" below and indented to the right, oversized tall C initials, tall h ascenders, small Korean "크로노 체인" to the right in the interline gap. Preserve exact spelling and square canvas with the same margins. Pure opaque black background.

CHANGE English typography: redraw the letter silhouettes as professionally crafted CUSTOM narrow semi-calligraphic display lettering, graceful tapered curves, slightly forward poised stance, deliberately sculpted tall C initials, elegant curved shoulders on h, shaped r terminals, refined a and n, intentional optical spacing. Clearly readable Chrono and Chain. No generic system font, no awkward childlike wire handwriting, no overly elaborate blackletter. Give the typography a recognizable visual identity.

CRITICAL chain construction: ALL English strokes must consist of tangible interlocking real silver-steel chain links, NOT a printed font with chain decoration. Give links moderate thickness, convincing rounded metal cross-section, alternating face-on oval links and narrower edge-on links threading through adjacent links. Small controlled cool silver highlights, dark graphite inner edges, restrained brushed-metal detail. Hollow links remain black inside. Links read as actual small physical chain, not neon outline rings or a dashed line. Build the custom letterforms out of this chain. Maintain a faint localized blue emitted light at link edges, dim and subtle, while metal itself stays silver and discernible. No big neon bloom.

CHANGE Korean lettering: exact "크로노 체인", small relative to English, a bespoke Korean title wordmark with refined lightly flared stroke endings, graceful slight stroke contrast and subtly angular chiseled terminals. Legible Korean with elegant contemporary literary-fantasy character. NOT default sans-serif, not a plain computer UI font. Neutral ivory-silver; no strong glow on Korean.

Balance sophistication with simplicity. No clock, emblem, surrounding chains, particles, sparkle, lens flare, rays, texture on background, ornamental flourishes or additional symbols. Restrained premium logo on empty black, ONLY the letters.
